source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Jazz French Door Refrigerator (W10322959B, 19–22 cu ft)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Continue in Service Test Mode
steps.body: Service Test Mode (S-E) entered. Use Freezer UP/DOWN to select the test number for this procedure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: You are now in the SERVICES TEST operational mode and may use the diagnostic tests.

steps.title: Select Service Test 3
steps.body: In Service Test Mode (S-E), use Freezer UP/DOWN keys until freezer display shows 3. Refrigerator display blank until test is activated.

steps.title: Activate test 3
steps.body: Press Refrigerator UP to toggle freezer fan ON (O) or OFF (F). Freezer displays 3.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press Refrigerator UP to toggle freezer fan ON (O) or OFF (F). Freezer displays 3.

steps.title: Evaporator fan operation
steps.body: Inspect evaporator/freezer fan for proper rotation and airflow. Blade fully seated on shaft (2800 RPM spec).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Inspect evaporator/freezer fan for proper rotation and airflow. Blade fully seated on shaft (2800 RPM spec).

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace evaporator fan motor or repair harness.

steps.title: Deactivate test 3
steps.body: Toggle fan OFF (F) before leaving test 3.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Toggle fan OFF (F) before leaving test 3.

steps.title: Replace evaporator fan
steps.oemOutcome: Replace freezer fan motor when it does not run in service test 3.

steps.title: Evaporator fan verified
steps.oemOutcome: Freezer fan operates correctly in service test 3.
